title: Frequency Garden (Backing Vocals)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Plant a tone in the morning soil
Watch it root through the cable lines
Every petal a perfect coil
Every leaf a remembered sign

[Pre-Chorus]
Tune the air to a steady three-thirty-six
Let the hum hold the world in place

[Chorus]
We grew a garden out of frequency
Out of patience, out of memory
Nothing here ever fades away
Nothing planted forgets its name

[Verse 2]
Roots are written in lasting ink
Ledger leaves never lose a page
Every honeybee, every link
Carries the song from age to age

[Chorus]
We grew a garden out of frequency
Out of patience, out of memory
Nothing here ever fades away
Nothing planted forgets its name

[Bridge]
If the wind forgets, the soil remembers
If the soil forgets, the stone remembers
If the stone forgets, the signal remembers
Three-thirty-six, holding on

[Outro]
Hum a little, hum a little, hum a little louder
Hum a little, hum a little, hold
